contracts: Images and audio require a unique actual model catalog match and explicit inputModalities. Missing/loading/ambiguous catalog does not imply support.
Normal send uses prepared collaboration mode/model options or current session/default model; queued input uses the session model and ignores send-only overrides.
Steering cannot infer current-turn model overrides from thread session defaults, so media remains blocked with a clear queued/next-turn path until current-turn capability can be proved.
Supported audio is described as native audio, never a text-path fallback. Draft text and attachments survive unsupported selection. Server format/model checks remain authoritative.
